candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year ended December 31, 2025, AS Tallinna Sadam Group demonstrated stable overall financial performance, characterized by improved profitability despite a minor decrease in total revenue.

Consolidated revenue declined by 0.8 percent compared with the previous year to EUR 118.7 million, primarily driven by lower charter fees for the icebreaker Botnica resulting from fewer operating days.
Despite the slight contraction in revenue, profitability indicators showed significant improvement.
Adjusted EBITDA grew by 6.4 percent to EUR 56.5 million, raising the adjusted EBITDA margin to 47.6 percent from 44.4 percent in the prior year.

Furthermore, net profit rose by 17.3 percent to EUR 22.5 million, supported by a 30 percent decrease in finance costs resulting from lower market interest rates and reduced loan liabilities, which outweighed an increase in income tax expense on dividends due to a higher tax rate.
Capital investments totaled EUR 33.2 million during the reporting period, representing a 14.4 percent decrease compared with the previous year.
The Group maintained a strong financial position, closing the year with total assets of EUR 622.1 million, total equity of EUR 380.9 million, and a reduced net debt of EUR 141.7 million.
